function.name: confirm_claim
function.description: Record the caller's yes or no to the read-back of the claim they are reporting. A yes files it. Call it right after they answer, with no words of your own, not even an acknowledgement: its result sentence acknowledges them and has already been spoken to the caller.

correct.description: true when the caller said the claim read back is right; false when they said something is wrong.

messages.content: Thanks for bearing with me, almost there.
I'm sorry, I couldn't file that just now. I can have a claims specialist call you back to finish it. Would you like that?
